result.keywords: This article investigates aggregation and fusion methods in a probabilistic fuzzy environment for granular and multi-attribute decision problems. Building on Einstein product and Einstein sum, we define probabilistic fuzzy operational laws for fuzzy information granules and develop several aggregation operators, including probabilistic fuzzy Einstein averaging and geometric operators, along with weighted variants. The proposed operators are studied through their algebraic properties and behavior under reinforcement effects. We further apply the operators to a multi-criteria group decision-making framework under uncertainty and illustrate the approach with a practical example. The results show that the model can represent layered uncertainty more flexibly than crisp aggregation schemes while remaining suitable for structured decision analysis.
result.title: Granular Probabilistic Fuzzy Aggregation Operators Based on Einstein t-Norms for Multi-Attribute Decision Structures.
